fullDescription: Verdance Studio style guide features an editorial-driven, dark-mode aesthetic centered around a nature-inspired 'Deep Forest' color palette. Key characteristics include high-contrast brass accents, a sophisticated pairing of Inter (sans-serif) and Fraunces (italic serif), and a grain-textured background. The layout uses asymmetric bento-style grids, infinite marquee scrolls, and glassmorphism. This design is ideal for high-end design agencies, architecture firms, luxury lifestyle brands, and boutique SaaS companies seeking a 'premium organic' feel.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated, dark-editorial web design style using a deep green and cream color palette with metallic brass accents, featuring bold typography, script-style italic emphasis, and grain textures.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using the following palette: Surface #0d1f17, Dark Surface #0a1711, Emerald #1f6f4f, Emerald Soft #2c8a63, Cream Text #f1ede3, Muted Cream #b8b3a6, and Brass Accents #c9a227. 

Typography: 
- Headings: Use Inter (700 weight, letter-spacing -0.045em, line-height 0.92, all-caps). 
- Script Accents: Use Fraunces Italic for editorial callouts, often overlapping headings or at the end of sentences with a soft emerald text shadow (0 1px 18px rgba(44,138,99,0.35)). 
- Body: Inter (400-500 weight) with generous leading.

Key Effects: 
- Background Texture: Apply a subtle grain overlay at 5% opacity using a fractal noise SVG.
- Borders: Use 'Hairline' borders (1px) with rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.32) opacity.
- Image Filters: Apply 55% saturation, 82% brightness, and 12% sepia to all images. 
- Image Hover: Transition to 78% saturation, 95% brightness, and 6% sepia over 0.7s with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
A fixed glassmorphic navigation bar (h-68px) with a forestDeep/70 background and 10px backdrop blur. Include a leaf icon in a brass circular border, capitalized nav links (WORK, SERVICES, etc.) with a 1px brass underline appearing on hover, and a capsule project button with a brass border.

### Hero Section
Top-aligned meta information with a 6px emerald dot. Main headline: massive all-caps Inter display font (12rem scale) with a script Fraunces italic word at the baseline of the second line. Right-aligned scroll cue featuring a circular button (14x14) with a brass border and a downward arrow that translates vertically on hover.

### Featured Visual
Full-width landscape image container (h-560px) separated by a 'brass-line' (gradient: transparent to 55% brass to transparent). Overlay the image with a forest-to-transparent gradient and a multiply-blend emerald tint. Include a bottom-aligned script caption and serial number (e.g., No. 001).

### Infinite Marquee
A continuous horizontal scrolling band (32s duration) containing uppercase award titles or brand names. Use #0a1711 background and #c9a227 brass diamond shapes (◆) as separators between entries.

### Project Grid
An asymmetric 2-column grid. Card 1: Tall (span 2 rows) with aspect-4/5. Cards 2 & 3: Square. Card 4: Wide editorial (span 2 columns) with a left-aligned floating content box using forestDeep/55 background and brass ring-1 border. All cards must feature the saturation/sepia image filter and a scaling effect on hover.

### Numbered Services
A vertical list of four rows separated by hairline borders. Each row contains an index (01, 02...), a Phosphor icon, a title, and a hidden-on-mobile description. Hover state: 10% emerald background wash and a brass arrow sliding 6px to the right.

### Closing CTA
A centered layout with grain texture. Heading: '有项目吗？' (Have a project?) in Inter display. Subheading: Fraunces script. Buttons: One solid brass capsule button with #0a1711 text and one ghost button with brass border. Place social icons in a row below the buttons.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Brass Line Divider — A sophisticated horizontal separator.
Height: 1px. Background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(201,162,39,0) 0%, rgba(201,162,39,0.55) 18%, rgba(201,162,39,0.55) 82%, rgba(201,162,39,0) 100%). Used to divide major sections like Hero and Feature Image.

### Editorial Project Card — Highly interactive cards with blended overlays.
Apply a 'tint' class using ::after pseudo-element: background linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(13,31,23,0.32), rgba(31,111,79,0.30)) with mix-blend-mode: multiply. The image inside should scale 1.05x on hover with a 0.7s cubic-bezier ease.

style.description: The style is 'Dark Nature Editorial'. It utilizes deep forest greens for surfaces, cream for high-legibility text, and brass for luxury metallic highlights. Typography pairs a heavy, tightly tracked sans-serif (Inter) for headers with a refined, flowing italic serif (Fraunces) for accents. Visuals are treated with low-saturation, high-contrast filters to maintain a moody, consistent atmosphere. Micro-interactions focus on smooth cubic-bezier transitions and soft light-wash hover effects.
